text.text_excerpt: I don't know why this place has such low ratings. I've been going to this restaurant for the past 6 years and it is consistently good. They give you nice size portions, the food is flavorful and the price is just right. When I worked close to this place I would buy lunch from here at least twice a month. I am no longer in the vicinity but I have been known to stop there on my way home to pick up dinner for the family. My family's favorite is of course the bourbon chicken. It is basically teriyaki chicken and it is sweet, salty and delicious. My other favorite is the black pepper chicken. If you dont like spicy, don't get it. My boyfriend and I's go to Chinese takeout! It's not the best Chinese, but It definitely perfect for what you're looking for. Get the Bourbon Chicken! Seriously, do it.

I LOVE this little restaurant. They are my #1 favorite Americanized-Chinese food place in New Orleans! This is a to-go fave for so many UNO students with us included. We've been coming here regularly for the past 5 years! I don't know how they aren't rated 4 stars or higher. Maybe college students don't leave too many reviews... This place is cheap and always consistently delicious! Their portions are perfect for "big-eaters" like us. Their cuts of meat are always quality with no tendon/fatty pieces!
